reason: Adds configurable image, GIF, and animated wallpaper backgrounds to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with a local asset library and support for official themes and skin-center skins.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 添加可开关的自定义图片、GIF 和动态壁纸背景，并提供本地资源库管理功能。
summaries.en: Adds toggleable custom image, GIF, and animated wallpaper backgrounds to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with a local asset library.

capabilities: customizes the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI background
uploads, lists, renames, refreshes, and deletes local image or GIF assets
persists the enable state in localStorage
serves selected assets through a local plugin API
